# Exactly.ai

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 2 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: brand-AI marketing: a Framer light-theme palette (#fb411f accent, #1e1e1e ink, #f7f7f7 canvas, #404040/#7c7c7c washes, on-image translucent whites) with a wght-300 Inter 47px display over a photo hero, inverted white chrome, 1000px pill CTAs (dark #1e1e1e on light, white on image), 40px-radius #f7f7f7 plan cards, a doc-style help rail, an at-rest scheduler embed, and a near-black footer.

Captured 2026-11-14, read-only (the marketing site, pricing, showcase, case studies, industries, help center and book-a-demo are fully public; everything on threads.exactly.ai is an authenticated boundary behind a Cloudflare check never bypassed; Log in, Start for free and Book a demo were measured, never followed; the help search was typed and cleared, never submitted; the scheduler was measured at rest). Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for Exactly.ai's public marketing site — for building brand-AI marketing pages, pricing tables, showcase galleries, doc-style help centers and footer treatments in the style of the real thing. It was read from **exactly.ai** on **2026-11-14**, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844. Captured: the home page, /pricing, /showcase and /showcase/revolut, /case-studies and one case-study article, /industries and /industries/saas-n-mobile-apps, the /help-center and its FAQ article, /book-a-demo at rest, plus 390px passes on home and pricing.

Exactly.ai is a Framer-published site, and it shows: the stylesheet declares a compact `--token-*` palette (the `#fb411f` accent, `#1e1e1e` ink, `#f7f7f7` canvas, `#404040` and `#7c7c7c` alpha washes, translucent whites for the photo surfaces) that the components' computed values resolve back to. Two served faces — **Inter** at wght 300 for the 47px/60px display and longform, **Inter Variable** for nav, CTAs, card titles and the footer. The whole public site paints one light theme; a single `prefers-color-scheme: dark` media rule repaints nothing. **Boundary:** the product itself — the studio, model training, the image generator, credits and billing — lives on threads.exactly.ai behind a Cloudflare check that was never bypassed; Log in, Start for free and Book a demo were measured, never followed; the help search was typed into and cleared, never submitted; the scheduler was measured at rest, never touched.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do spend the orange once.** `#fb411f` (`light.accent`) fills the Start-for-free pill on interior pages and the For-free chip — on the photo hero the same action paints white instead (`light.pill.light`). Everything else is black, white or grey. See [nav-cta](components/crops/nav-cta-default.png) and the orange variant inside [compare-bar](components/crops/compare-bar-default.png).
2. **Do keep the on-image recipe.** Over photography, text is white at 100/60/40% (`light.on-image.*`), pills are solid white or 10% glass with a 20% white edge — never tinted. See [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png).
3. **Do use the wght-300 display.** Headings are Inter at weight 300, 47px/60px with −1.88px tracking on desktop, 27px/36px on mobile — a light voice, not a bold one. See [hero-h1](components/crops/hero-h1-default.png).
4. **Do pill the actions.** CTAs, nav chips and the compare bar are 1000px pills; cards take 40px, the drawer shell 100px. See [plan-cta](components/crops/plan-cta-default.png).
5. **Do pair the pill paints.** Light surfaces use the dark `#1e1e1e` pill with white ink (`light.pill.dark`); over imagery it's the white pill with black ink (`light.pill.light`). The orange accent is reserved for the top-level conversion action. See [plan-card](components/crops/plan-card-default.png).
6. **Don't style the signed-in product from this package.** threads.exactly.ai was never reached; the studio, generator and account surfaces are a documented boundary, not inferable from the marketing site.
7. **Don't invent a dark theme.** The public site paints light only; the near-black footer is a section, not a theme. See [footer](components/crops/footer-default.png).
8. **Don't treat wrapper colours as the product's.** Several Framer anchor wrappers report the browser's default link blue/pressed red while the painted text inside carries the real value — read the text node's colour, as each entry's Text row does.

### Known gaps (from README.md)

- `showcase-chip`, `read-more` and `help-search`: keyboard focus never reached them, so their `focus-visible` readings are the element at rest: components.md leaves them out and `raw/measurements.md` shows them as Skipped. Needs a recapture; `measure.mjs` now records such a state as skipped (edited, not run).
- `article-quote` is a stale entry: a 2026-11-13 run marked it missing and the script no longer measures it, but the prune runs only on a full run, so it stays in `raw/components-computed.json` and components.md until the next one.
- `light.focus.ring` (#101010) and `light.focus.ring-mobile` (#e59700) are `outline: auto` rings in the colours Chrome uses for its own focus ring on the desktop pass and under the phone emulation. The site sets no focus colour; the tokens say so in their source.
- **Automation was masked during capture.** Until 2026-11-20, `tools/capture/public/lib.mjs` hid `navigator.webdriver` in every page it opened, so every committed reading was taken with that mask. The mask is removed (a bot check is now recorded as a boundary, not bypassed); whether any page needed it to load is not known, and a recapture without it is the check.
